doc: The abstract, harness-agnostic entity registry — THE source the scaffolded core surface derives from. dadaia-workspace defines behaviors, personas, rules and skills agnostically; each harness receives an IMPLEMENTATION of them. A scaffolded core sub-agent without a Persona here, a core hook without a Deterministic Behavior here, or a core rule without an Abstract Rule here is forbidden (constitution, Anti-Slop Law, Derivation law). Operator-created entities are out of scope.

personas.mandate: Coordinator and sole dispatch authority: intake, grill-me, backlog curation, dispatching every other persona. Never writes code, specs, memory or tests.
Spec author and memory guardian: SPEC/PLAN/TASKS/CLOSURE and specs/memory/**. Never dispatches or implements code.
Generic implementer: production code and its tests, TDD-first, inside the task's declared write set.
E2E and test-pyramid owner; validates deploys; the pre-commit review checkpoint.
Six-axis review before a PR (architecture/patterns/tests/security/perf/dead code). Never edits code.
Vulnerability auditor and the PR verdict gate: OWASP, secrets, CVEs; emits the sha-matched PR verdict (branch contract: DADAIA.md §4 Gitflow).
Anti-slop architecture specialist: DRAFT/REVIEW/ONBOARD; root-cause and fidelity gates on every spec review.
Drift anchor: audits specs/memory vs code, dispatches evidence agents, scores compliance. Never fixes drift.
Exclusive owner of the AI surface: agents, skills, rules, hooks, context engineering, model tiering.

behaviors.mandate: The workspace root holds only the sanctioned entries; any file-tool write that would mint a new top-level entry is blocked.

implementations.kimi-code: managed hook block in $KIMI_CODE_HOME/config.toml → the same Python gate

behaviors.mandate: dadaia/pip/python -m dadaia_workspace run only from the workspace venv; the block message carries the corrected command.

implementations.kimi-code: managed hook block → the same Python gate

behaviors.mandate: Path class × presence × phase × mode on every write: ADDITIVE always writable, MEMORY phase-gated, FROZEN/PROTECTED/LAW blocked; races surfaced, never prevented.

implementations.claude: PreToolUse hook via dadaia_workspace.hooks.pre_gate (single merged entrypoint) + PostToolUse advisory presence via dadaia_workspace.hooks.sdd_post_gate
implementations.codex: .codex/hooks.json wrapper → the same Python gate (pre + post)
implementations.kimi-code: managed hook block → the same Python gate (pre + post)

behaviors.mandate: The session's own bind selects which product memory is injected at prompt time; never another session's bind.

implementations.codex: session bootstrap via the projected wrapper (headless sessions read AGENTS.md natively)
implementations.kimi-code: managed hook block → the same ctx_inject module

behaviors.mandate: Harness-independent: pre-commit warns on peer presence and always allows; pre-push allows only feature/{M.m.p} pushes with a green CI preflight and refuses develop/main direct pushes; the security APPROVE verdict is a CI PR gate keyed to the PR head sha, not a pre-push check (branch contract: DADAIA.md §4 Gitflow).

implementations.claude: .dadaia git hooks (pre-commit-presence-gate.sh, pre-push-ci-gate.sh) — identical for every harness

rules.mandate: DADAIA.md — the one always-on law file (the workspace system prompt), projected read-only per harness; human-only in an instantiated workspace.
Codex-native executable command policy derived from the venv-guard behavior (Starlark, the only rule dialect Codex executes).

universal.doc: Harness-agnostic by construction — every supported harness reads these natively, so they need no per-harness derivation and no harness toggle.
